picks.why: Seagate grows revenue 61% at a 49% operating margin on 10.8x forward earnings and sits 39% below its 52-week high, a price cushion in a segment we rate overweight with only MU on the watchlist. Sandisk's sold-out-through-the-decade call supports the storage shortage thesis.
picks.risk: FCF yield is only 1% and the stock is just 1% above its 200-day, so a memory-cycle peak call or lighter hyperscaler capex would hit it.

picks.why: TSMC earns a 59% operating margin with 51% revenue growth at 18.5x forward earnings, the cheapest quality name in a segment that is -17.4% on the month. It supplies every compute design regardless of which hyperscaler wins, which is the Buffett-style toll-road way to own compute demand.
picks.risk: FCF yield is just 2% from heavy capex and a 5% 10-year plus Taiwan risk could compress the multiple further.
